exposure: women who underwent a non-indicated CS in their first delivery
mode of first delivery (CS vs. SVD)
outcome: caesarean section delivery in subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Women who underwent singleton deliveries at the International Peace Maternity and Child Health Hospital from January 2013 to December 2016
finding: Caesarean section in the first delivery was associated with an increased risk of repeated CS and various maternal and fetal complications in the subsequent pregnancy, particularly for women who had a non-indicated CS in their first delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section in the first delivery markedly increases the risk of repeated CS and maternal-fetal complications in the subsequent pregnancy, especially in women with a non-indicated CS.
